items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: even worse than Ted Lewis in some ways

ctx.x: He said, I'm Wilton Crawley, the world's greatest clarinet player.

And he said, five, six, seven. He's going to go take him and lock him up, too. See, Crawley was about the corniest, if you remember the record, about the corniest player, even worse than Ted Lewis in some ways. He was a contortionist.
